title: La Voz de la instrucción

verification_note: HNDM descriptor identifies 24 numbers in 1871 and explicit focus on teaching and the Mexican teaching profession

title: La Enseñanza
subtitle_or_scope: Revista americana de instrucción y recreo dedicada a la juventud
verification_note: HNDM descriptor records pedagogical content and describes the journal as support for teachers' work

title: La Educación
subtitle_or_scope: Periódico de la Sociedad de Enseñanza Popular
verification_note: HNDM descriptor documents the periodical and its direct relation to popular teaching and adult night schools

title: La Enseñanza Objetiva
subtitle_or_scope: Periódico dedicado a la propagación y adelanto de este sistema y a la educación civil y moral de la juventud
verification_note: HNDM digitized issue: tomo XIII, número 49; contains a model lesson of explained reading and is a strong candidate for pedagogical-act annotation

title: La Escuela moderna
subtitle_or_scope: Periódico pedagógico; issues indexed by the UNAM repository
verification_note: UNAM repository exposes digitized issues including 1889-1891 and a record dated 1899-12-31; exact full serial span remains to be normalized

title: La Enseñanza primaria
subtitle_or_scope: Publicación por y para profesores de enseñanza primaria
verification_note: UNAM repository provides object-level records beginning in 1901; historical scholarship identifies the pedagogical journal across 1901-1911

title: Revista de la Instrucción Pública Mexicana
subtitle_or_scope: Publicación periódica sobre instrucción pública y pedagogía
verification_note: HNDM provides digitized issues from 1896 onward; historical scholarship places the title in 1896-1902 before the Boletín de Instrucción Pública

title: El Escolar Mexicano
subtitle_or_scope: Periódico de instrucción, moral y recreo, dedicado a la niñez y a los profesores de enseñanza primaria
verification_note: Digitized HNDM issue from 2 September 1888 explicitly addresses children and primary teachers and contains pedagogical material associated with objective teaching

title: El Porvenir de la niñez
subtitle_or_scope: Publicación de la Sociedad Lancasteriana
verification_note: HNDM descriptor identifies it as the dissemination organ of the Lancasterian Company and documents issues, schools and popular primary education

title: El Protector de la infancia
subtitle_or_scope: Periódico de la Compañía Lancasteriana jalisciense
verification_note: HNDM descriptor records ten monthly issues and direct circulation through Lancasterian schools

title: El Instructor de los niños
subtitle_or_scope: Publicación instructiva y recreativa dirigida a la infancia
verification_note: HNDM descriptor links the publication to educational instruction and to Antonio Matías Rebolledo's pedagogical production

title: El Periquito
subtitle_or_scope: Periódico de los niños; instrucción y amenidad
verification_note: HNDM descriptor documents the 1870 Campeche third epoch and the explicit maxim 'Instrucción. Amenidad'

title: El Correo de los niños
subtitle_or_scope: Semanario dedicado a la infancia mexicana
verification_note: HNDM descriptor supplies a long 1872-1883 run and documents its evolving educational subtitles and circulation

title: La Escuela de primeras letras
subtitle_or_scope: Prensa pedagógica vinculada con la enseñanza primaria
verification_note: HNDM confirms the title; the 1870-1871 span is retained as a working chronology to be resolved at issue level

title: El Sábado
subtitle_or_scope: Periódico para las escuelas y padres de familia
verification_note: HNDM descriptor records sections on primary instruction and popular reading and an explicit purpose of educational reform

title: El Maestro

verification_note: SIHENA documents the national cultural magazine launched in 1921 in the Vasconcelos educational project, with indexed content useful for pedagogical and teacher-culture analysis

title: Revista Mexicana de Educación
subtitle_or_scope: Revista educativa de circulación nacional
verification_note: HNDM exposes issues from late 1919 through 1921; candidate bridges late revolutionary and early SEP pedagogical discourse

title: La Enseñanza Moderna
subtitle_or_scope: Revista Pedagógica; segunda época

title: El Instructor
subtitle_or_scope: Periódico científico y literario fundado en 1884 bajo la dirección de Jesús Díaz de León
verification_note: Cervantes Virtual confirms foundation in 1884 and preserves a substantial run; educational relevance will be sampled rather than assumed for every issue

title: México Intelectual
subtitle_or_scope: Revista pedagógica y científico literaria
verification_note: Universidad Veracruzana identifies Rébsamen as redactor and describes theories, methodologies, school subjects, practical advice and school news; holdings extend through 1904

title: La Enseñanza Normal
subtitle_or_scope: Publicación periódica de la Dirección General de la Enseñanza Normal en el Distrito Federal
verification_note: Cervantes Virtual catalogs 34 issues from 1904-1906 and identifies pedagogical and educational subject headings

title: El Educador Práctico Ilustrado
subtitle_or_scope: Publicación pedagógica mexicana documentada mediante reproducción en investigación universitaria
verification_note: UNAM thesis reproduces a page identified as El Educador Práctico Ilustrado, Ciudad de México, año 1 de 1886; primary serial record still needs resolution

title: El Magisterio Nacional
subtitle_or_scope: Periódico orientado a constituir un órgano nacional del profesorado
verification_note: El Colegio de México scholarship identifies a 1904 start under Julio S. Hernández and an explicit project of national professional organization; primary serial record pending

title: El Maestro Rural
subtitle_or_scope: Revista quincenal; órgano del Departamento de Misiones Culturales de la SEP
verification_note: UAM scholarship identifies the 1932 publication and its role in rural-teacher formation, indigenous and adult education, and state educational policy; primary issue catalog pending

title: Revista de Educación
subtitle_or_scope: Publicación educativa vinculada con la SEP y la educación socialista
verification_note: UAM study analyzes 1937 and 1939 issues as an official educational publishing project; full serial chronology and primary catalog remain to be resolved
